zh.summary: 用可審查的提交保存每次切片，還原時明確指定來源與路徑，保留其他尚未完成的工作。
objectives: 分辨工作區、暫存區、提交與遠端發布。
建立能對應規格的單一目的提交。
在獨立練習中局部還原並保留其他修改。

readingGuide.goal: 分辨工作區、暫存區、提交與遠端發布。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 已安裝 Git、編輯器與新建空白 git-lab/；不用真實資料或遠端。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份能對應目的的提交及局部還原紀錄，其他工作保持原樣。

sections.heading: 讓變更有理由，也有可找回的起點
paragraphs: M07 的 Diff 告訴你現在改了什麼，Git 提交（Commit）則保存暫存區的專案快照，讓下次能比較、定位及回復。每次切片先核對驗收情境，再把相關檔案放進同一個有目的的提交。
提交保存在本機，不代表已推送遠端、部署或通過驗收。這些狀態分開記錄；也不要把真實資料、金鑰或未確認可公開的內容寫進歷史。

sections.heading: 像整理一份能追溯修訂的工程紀錄
paragraphs: 工作臺上可能同時放著不同任務的材料；暫存區像本次要歸檔的清單，提交是實際封存的一版。只記一句「完成」會讓接手者難以知道它對應哪個要求。
好的提交說明指出變更目的，例如「表單切片：新增三欄及未檢核預覽」。測試與限制可在相關紀錄連結，不把無關修正一併混入。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從修改到可追溯提交
blocks.description: 先核對範圍再保存；遠端發布與實際部署另行驗證。

items.title: 審查 Diff
items.body: 核對規格及修改範圍，也查看未追蹤檔案。

items.title: 暫存指定路徑
items.body: 只加入這次準備提交的內容。

items.title: 提交快照
items.body: 記錄目的與版本，再分別處理推送及部署。

sections.heading: 先在獨立目錄練習
paragraphs: 新建並進入空白 git-lab/，不要在既有專案或包含其他工作的位置初始化。以下身分只供本機合成練習；正式專案使用自己獲准的署名設定，不修改全域設定。
用編輯器建立 slice-notes.md，內容記「切片一：三欄輸入及未檢核預覽」，再建立 keep.txt，內容記「其他工作：原始紀錄」。另建 .gitignore，排除 .venv/、__pycache__/、.pytest_cache/ 與 .env；忽略規則不會自動清除已追蹤檔案或歷史中的內容。

blocks.heading: 初始化本機練習
paragraphs: 只在剛建立的空白 git-lab/ 執行，不設定遠端，也不推送。
blocks.code:
git init
git config user.name "AASE Learner"
git config user.email "aase@example.invalid"

blocks.heading: .gitignore｜練習內容
paragraphs: 逐行放入 .gitignore；這些模式不取代提交前的內容檢查。

blocks.heading: 建立基準提交
paragraphs: 確認三個檔案內容後，逐路徑暫存；不要用全目錄加入代替審查。
blocks.code:
git status --short
git add .gitignore slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached
git commit -m "建立合成切片紀錄基準"
git log -1 --oneline

sections.heading: 分清兩種差異與未追蹤檔案
paragraphs: git diff 預設看工作區相對暫存區，git diff --cached 看準備提交的內容相對 HEAD。新檔案尚未追蹤時要另看 status 及檔案內容；沒有 diff 不能推定完全沒有修改。
完成基準提交後，在 slice-notes.md 加入「誤加：完整報告已完成」，在 keep.txt 加入「其他工作：尚待完成」。查看差異，確認兩者都只在工作區，且暫存區沒有這次修改。

blocks.heading: 還原前的唯讀核對
paragraphs: 先保留現況；若有別人的或已暫存修改，先停止這個簡化練習並釐清範圍。
blocks.code:
git status --short
git diff -- slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached -- slice-notes.md keep.txt

sections.heading: 只還原已確認的路徑
paragraphs: 先用編輯器把目前 slice-notes.md 另存為 slice-notes.backup.md，確認副本可讀。以下明確從 HEAD 回復工作區的 slice-notes.md，會覆蓋該檔目前內容；keep.txt 的其他修改應保持。
這個練習以目標檔只有本次修改為前提。若同一檔案混有其他工作，先保留副本並分段處理，不整份覆蓋。還原後核對檔案及 Diff；程式檔則需重跑受影響測試。

blocks.heading: 局部回復基準
paragraphs: 僅在本篇獨立練習且已保留副本後執行。
blocks.code:
git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- keep.txt
git status --short

sections.heading: 用歷史支持接手與復原
paragraphs: 將此方法帶回三次切片：每次提交對應規格、修改及測試結果，交接時提供提交識別碼。修復已公開變更時要遵循專案協作流程，不能為了整理紀錄任意重寫別人的歷史。
Git 保存的是你交給它的內容；沒有提交或另存的工作仍需保護。本機提交也不是遠端備份、權限控制或個資清理工具。下一篇把啟動、限制與復原方式整理到 README。

exercise.environment: 已安裝 Git、編輯器與新建空白 git-lab/；不用真實資料或遠端。
steps: 建立練習檔、忽略規則及基準提交，記錄提交目的。
分別修改 slice-notes.md 與 keep.txt，檢查工作區及暫存區，再保留目標副本。
只還原 slice-notes.md，核對它回到基準、keep.txt 修改與副本仍在。
exercise.expected: 一份能對應目的的提交及局部還原紀錄，其他工作保持原樣。
exercise.check: 不使用整個專案的強制重設；能指出提交、推送、部署與驗收的差別。
exercise.cleanup: 保留練習結果或自行刪除整個獨立練習目錄；不要在正常專案執行練習的覆蓋操作。

en.summary: Preserve each slice in a reviewable commit, naming recovery sources and paths explicitly while retaining other unfinished work.
objectives: Distinguish working tree, staging area, commit and remote publication.
Create a single-purpose commit traceable to a specification.
Restore a selected path in an independent lab while preserving other edits.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish working tree, staging area, commit and remote publication.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Git, an editor and a new empty git-lab/; use neither real data nor a remote.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A purpose-linked commit and selective-restoration record with other work preserved.

sections.heading: Give Changes a Reason and a Recoverable Starting Point
paragraphs: M07 diffs show current changes; a Git commit records the project snapshot prepared in the staging area for later comparison, diagnosis and recovery. Check each slice’s acceptance scenarios, then group related files into one purposeful commit.
A local commit does not establish remote push, deployment or acceptance. Record those statuses separately and keep real data, keys and unapproved public material out of history.

sections.heading: Maintain a Traceable Engineering Record
paragraphs: A workbench may hold material for different tasks. The staging area resembles the selected material to archive now; a commit records that version. “Done” alone does not explain the requirement it serves.
A useful message states purpose, such as “Form slice: add three fields and an unvalidated preview.” Link relevant tests and limits without mixing unrelated repairs into that commit.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Edits to a Traceable Commit
blocks.description: Review scope before recording it. Verify remote publication and actual deployment separately.

items.title: Review the diff
items.body: Check specification/scope and inspect untracked files too.

items.title: Stage selected paths
items.body: Include only content ready for this commit.

items.title: Commit the snapshot
items.body: Record purpose and version, then handle push and deployment separately.

sections.heading: Practice in a Separate Directory First
paragraphs: Create and enter an empty git-lab/, preserving existing projects and other work. The identity below is for this local synthetic exercise only; use authorized authorship in real projects and leave global configuration unchanged.

Create slice-notes.md with “切片一：三欄輸入及未檢核預覽” (slice one: three fields and unvalidated preview), and keep.txt with “其他工作：原始紀錄” (other work: original note). Add .gitignore entries for .venv/, __pycache__/, .pytest_cache/ and .env. Ignore rules do not remove already tracked files or historical content.

blocks.heading: Initialize the Local Lab
paragraphs: Run only in the new empty git-lab/, without configuring a remote or pushing.
blocks.code:
git init
git config user.name "AASE Learner"
git config user.email "aase@example.invalid"

blocks.heading: .gitignore | Exercise Contents
paragraphs: Put these patterns on separate lines. They do not replace pre-commit content inspection.

blocks.heading: Create a Baseline Commit
paragraphs: Inspect the three files, then stage explicit paths. The retained Chinese commit message means “create synthetic slice-record baseline.”
blocks.code:
git status --short
git add .gitignore slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached
git commit -m "建立合成切片紀錄基準"
git log -1 --oneline

sections.heading: Distinguish Both Diffs and Untracked Files
paragraphs: git diff compares the working tree with staging by default; git diff --cached compares staged content with HEAD. Inspect status and contents for untracked files. An empty diff does not establish that nothing changed anywhere.

After the baseline, append “誤加：完整報告已完成” (mistaken claim: complete report finished) to slice-notes.md and “其他工作：尚待完成” (other work: pending) to keep.txt. Check that both edits are in the working tree only, with neither staged.

blocks.heading: Read-only Checks Before Restoration
paragraphs: Preserve current state. If another person’s work or staged edits are present, stop this simplified exercise and establish scope first.
blocks.code:
git status --short
git diff -- slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached -- slice-notes.md keep.txt

sections.heading: Restore Only the Confirmed Path
paragraphs: First save the current slice-notes.md as readable slice-notes.backup.md. The command explicitly restores the working-tree slice-notes.md from HEAD, overwriting its current contents. Other edits in keep.txt must remain.

This exercise assumes the target contains only this task’s edit. For mixed work, preserve a copy and recover selected sections instead of overwriting the whole file. Check files and diffs afterward, rerunning affected tests for program changes.

blocks.heading: Recover the Baseline Selectively
paragraphs: Use only in this independent lab after saving the backup.
blocks.code:
git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- keep.txt
git status --short

sections.heading: Use History for Handoff and Recovery
paragraphs: Apply the method to the three slices: connect each commit to requirements, changes and test results, and give successors its identifier. Follow project collaboration rules for published changes; preserve other people’s history rather than rewriting it for tidiness.

Git preserves content entrusted to it. Protect uncommitted or unsaved work separately. A local commit is neither a remote backup, permission control nor personal-data cleanup tool. The next lesson records startup, limits and recovery in README.

exercise.environment: Git, an editor and a new empty git-lab/; use neither real data nor a remote.
steps: Create the exercise files, ignore rules and baseline commit; record its purpose.
Edit slice-notes.md and keep.txt, inspect working/staged differences and save the target backup.
Restore only slice-notes.md; verify its baseline, retained keep.txt edit and preserved backup.
exercise.expected: A purpose-linked commit and selective-restoration record with other work preserved.
exercise.check: Use no whole-project forced reset. Distinguish commit, push, deployment and acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the lab results or delete only the independent lab directory; do not perform the exercise’s overwrite operations in a normal project.

options: 暫存區準備的專案快照
rationales: 未加入者不會自動進入。

en.prompt: What does a commit most directly record?
options: The project snapshot prepared in staging.
rationales: Files not added are not included automatically.

zh.prompt: 目標檔混有其他工作，還原前應怎麼做？
options: 先保留現況並釐清或分段回復
rationales: 確認來源、路徑與保留範圍。

en.prompt: The target file contains other work. What should precede restoration?
options: Preserve current state and clarify scope or recover selected sections.
rationales: Identify source, paths and what must remain.
That does not restore file content.

zh.prompt: 加上 .gitignore 就能清除歷史秘密嗎？
options: 不能，仍需檢查已追蹤內容與依事件處理
rationales: 需針對實際暴露採取措施。

options: No; inspect tracked content and respond to the actual exposure.
rationales: Ignoring does not change existing history.
Push does not remove it automatically.
